correctness.rationale: For each normalized jointly ±π/4-spirallike f, q=zf'/f maps the disk into the sector |arg q|<π/4, so p=q² has positive real part with p(0)=1. Conversely principal sqrt p integrates to admissible f. The Carathéodory variability disk at radius 3/5 is |p-17/8|≤15/8. Replacing p=(u+iv)² gives C=4(u²+v²)²-17(u²-v²)+4≤0. Its intersection with parabolic boundary u=(1+v²)/2 is C=v²(v⁶+12v⁴+21v²+46)/4, zero only at (u,v)=(1/2,0); exact coefficient expansion independently checked. Since the square-root image is connected and includes q=1, open image lies inside the parabola. Canonical p=(1+z)/(1-z) reaches q=1/2 at z=-3/5 and exits for more negative z. Thus R=3/5 including sharpness, with open-disk endpoint convention correct.
residual_risks: Sharpness is for a universal open-disk radius, not global inclusion; neither algebraic contact computation alone nor numerical plots replace the connectedness and analytic realization arguments.
